sections.label: Healthier Choice and Dining programmes
sections.summary: HPB works with industry partners to expand the Healthier Choice Symbol and Healthier Dining programmes, with over 3,500 HCS products and 50% of hawker stalls offering a healthier option.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Health Promotion Board (HPB) has been working with industry partners to expand the coverage of its Healthier Choice Symbol (HCS) Programme and the Healthier Dining Programme (HDP).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: There are currently more than 3,500 HCS products available across 100 food categories and their sales have been growing at 9% annually.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: As for HDP, with more partners coming on board, 50% of the stalls across all hawker centres and coffee shops now have at least one healthier option in their menu.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Since then, 11 suppliers have tapped on the grant to produce 62 lower sugar products, helping to improve the availability of healthier options across retail and dining outlets.

sections.label: Daily sugar intake from drinks
sections.summary: Daily sugar intake remains high at 60 grammes, with drinks, especially pre-packaged drinks, the largest single contributor.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Our daily sugar intake remains high at 60 grammes (gm), with drinks, in particular pre-packaged drinks, being the largest single contributor of sugar.

sections.label: Two funded research collaborations
sections.summary: Two research collaborations have just been funded through the National Medical Research Council Open Fund - Large Scale Collaborative Grant.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In fact, there are also two research collaborations that have just been funded through the National Medical Research Council Open Fund – Large Scale Collaborative Grant.

sections.label: Diabetes test strip subsidies
sections.summary: Test strips for Type 1 and Type 2 patients on insulin have recently been allowed under CDMP to ensure affordability of diabetes treatment.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Regarding the subsidies, to ensure affordability of treatment for diabetes, just to note that we have just recently, for instance, allowed the test strips for diabetes for Type 1 and Type 2 patients on insulin to be under CDMP.

sections.label: Public consultation on sugar measures
sections.summary: A public consultation on measures to reduce Singaporeans' sugar intake, particularly from pre-packaged sugar-sweetened beverages, concluded in January with feedback from over 4,000 members of the public and industry.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: With regard to sugar, Members know that we have undertaken a public consultation on the measures to be taken to reduce Singaporeans' sugar intake, particularly from pre-packaged sugar-sweetened beverages (SSBs), which was just concluded in January this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We received feedback from over 4,000 members of the public as well as from the SSB and media industries.
